headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 4, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 4-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Max Meyer earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 7 strikeouts. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other action, the Detroit Tigers defeated the Tampa Bay Rays 7-2 behind a strong performance from their pitching staff, while the Chicago White Sox shut out the Minnesota Twins 8-0. The New York Mets also secured a 7-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Joe Mantiply, a left-handed pitcher for the Toronto Blue Jays, has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to left knee inflammation. Travis d'Arnaud, the catcher for the Los Angeles Angels, has also been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right foot plantar fasciitis. Other players who have been placed on the injured list include Matt Gage of the San Francisco Giants, Rob Zastryzny of the Milwaukee Brewers, Nick Sogard of the Boston Red Sox, Jonathan Heasley of the Tampa Bay Rays, Braden Shewmake of the Houston Astros, and Carlos Correa of the Houston Astros.

There have been several trades and roster movements in the past 24 hours. The Minnesota Twins traded RHP Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash. The Pittsburgh Pirates traded RHP Justin Lawrence to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Connor Seabold to the Toronto Blue Jays for LHP Juanmi Vasquez. The Colorado Rockies traded LHP Carson Palmquist to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Nationals 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 4-1 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Max Meyer earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 7 strikeouts. Esteury Ruiz led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Rays 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a 7-2 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI night.

top_news.title: **White Sox Shut Out Twins 8-0**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox dominated the Minnesota Twins, securing an 8-0 victory. Andrew Benintendi led the offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key homer that scored Miguel Vargas.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Mariners 7-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, with Freddy Peralta earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 1 earned run. J.P. Crawford led the Mariners' offense with 3 hits, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Joe Mantiply Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Joe Mantiply, a left-handed pitcher, has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays due to left knee inflammation.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Acquire Simeon Woods Richardson in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins traded RHP Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash on June 3, 2026.
